change.description: At saturated sequential SWA512 with no explicit eviction, compile the retained output-sharded DPP-QK owner with physical_slot=logical_slot and all slots visible. This removes per-slot base-offset, token-position, eviction-mask, and shared physical-slot traffic while preserving every QK product/addition, softmax operation, denominator update, ordered scalar PV FMA, gate, BF16 store, ABI, ownership, and dispatch.
change.qualification: gfx1151 gated natural SWA72/KV8/D128, live_count=capacity=512, retained DPP-QK enabled, and dense-initial metadata still valid
change.fallback: Pre-saturation, explicit eviction, reset-invalidated/non-dense metadata, and unqualified backends use the retained generic DPP-QK KVLiveSpans owner.
